A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''heir''' of the [[House Nalju/Legends|House Nalju]], one of the [[Great Houses/Legends|Great Houses of Serenno]], was the son of [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Unidentified House Nalju count|Nalju]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="FH" />

{{RPGseed}}
During their investigation in Nalju territory on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]], a group of [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] hired to locate a missing [[Unidentified House Demici heir|heir]] to [[House Demici/Legends|House Demici]] by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Unidentified House Demici count|Demici]] were captured and accused of espionage and brought to a [[Unidentified House Nalju encampment|House Nalju encampment]] led by an heir of Count Nalju. Young Nalju claimed that he was investigating a sighting of [[Noble Guard|House Demici Noble Guard]] and that he would gladly escort the Demici heir home if he found him, in order to avoid war between their houses. The group learned that House Nalju was not responsible for the boy's disappearance.<ref name="FH" />

In the middle of the night, the Nalju encampment was [[Raid on a House Nalju encampment|attacked]] by House Demici Noble Guardsmen. The heir to House Nalju was stunned and abducted into the forest. The group followed the kidnappers to a canyon. Once inside, they discovered the two heirs have allied to drive their houses to war. They had planned to kill their fathers during the confusion and take over their respective houses, and after a brief arms race, unite House Demici and House Nalju and dominate Serenno.<ref name="FH" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
A House Nalju heir was first mentioned in the role-playing sourcebook ''[[Far Horizons]]'' released in [[2014]] and developed by [[Sam Stewart]].<ref name="FH" />
